name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: The LinkedIn URL of the person whose conversation you want to sync in Sales Navigator

name: days
label: Sync Days
help: Syncing period, not the depth of history: how many days new messages keep being added to the loaded history (1-90, default 30). The whole conversation is read regardless. Counted from the moment the action starts running; a reply does not extend it. Syncing the same person again keeps the history already collected and never shortens the period.
